scope_note: Residual modeled synthesis after the Google Bridgeport evidence audit. It retains published Deloitte/Google IMPLAN channels as source-modeled outputs, deterministic presentation of uncataloged direct environmental series, exact annual paid-tax aggregations plus a 2025 equal-cost threshold, and three low-confidence descriptive county comparison gaps. It does not allocate campus/state results to the selected building, invent supplier spend/payroll/public costs, convert workers to job-years, estimate incentives or net fiscal impact, or treat source projections as actuals.
